title: build_inspector's sole_path_holds matches its row against the '/'-keyed import graph on every box
intention: sole_path_holds reds a second door to the inference host on every box, Windows included.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) at main: test_inspector.py's planted-dialer tooth red 'the planted dialer must red exactly sole_path_holds: []'. sole_path_holds built its row prefix as component + os.sep, a backslash there, while import_sieve.import_graph keys every file with '/' (3db1656ee), so no key matched and a second door to the inference host read green on Windows. Sealed green on Linux.
how: D1: sole_path_holds builds its row prefix as component + '/', the import graph's separator on every box. D2: new proof test_sole_path_reads_a_slash_graph_on_every_box.py pins the inspector's os.sep to a backslash, so its teeth red the os.sep prefix on Linux too.
